habitat: Subtropical/tropical moist lowland and montane forests
story: Explore the fascinating world of the Asian Emerald Cuckoo (Chrysococcyx maculatus). Classified under the Cuculidae family, this bird predominantly inhabits Subtropical/tropical moist lowland and montane forests. The current IUCN classification of Least Concern (LC) underscores the importance of safeguarding its natural range. From its feeding habits to its nesting preferences, the Asian Emerald Cuckoo is a testament to the intricate web of life. By studying species like the Asian Emerald Cuckoo, we gain valuable insights into broader ecological trends.
